mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(totalAmt), 0) FROM expense WHERE expenseStatus = 'posted'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM expense WHERE expenseStatus = 'draft' AND expenseDt BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL DAY(CURDATE()) - 1 DAY) -- 이번 달 1일 AND LAST_DAY(CURDATE()) -- 이번 달 말일

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(x.y, '%Y-%m') AS ym, IFNULL(SUM(r.totalAmt), 0) AS total FROM ( /* 최근 12개월의 월 첫날 목록 */ SELECT DATE_FORMAT( DATE_SUB( DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL DAY(CURDATE()) - 1 DAY), INTERVAL n.n MONTH ), '%Y-%m-01' ) AS y FROM (SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11) n) x LEFT JOIN revenue r ON r.revenueDt >= x.y AND r.revenueDt < DATE_ADD(x.y, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY x.y ORDER BY x.y

SELECT IFNULL((SELECT SUM(i.totalAmt) FROM invoice i WHERE i.invoiceStatus = 'paid' AND i.invoiceDt >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL DAY(CURDATE()) - 1 DAY) AND i.invoiceDt < DATE_ADD(LAST_DAY(CURDATE()), INTERVAL 1 DAY)), 0) - IFNULL((SELECT SUM(e.totalAmt) FROM expense e WHERE e.expenseStatus = 'posted' AND e.expenseDt >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL DAY(CURDATE()) - 1 DAY) AND e.expenseDt < DATE_ADD(LAST_DAY(CURDATE()), INTERVAL 1 DAY)), 0) AS netProfit
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(w.whUseCapa), 0) AS usedCapa, IFNULL(SUM(w.whTotalCapa), 0) AS totalCapa, FLOOR(100 * IFNULL(SUM(w.whUseCapa), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(w.whTotalCapa), 0)) AS usageRatePct FROM warehouse w

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(II.inDttmRecv, '%Y-%m-%d') AS chart_key, SUM(II.inQty) AS total_quantity FROM inboundItems II INNER JOIN inboundRequests IR ON II.inReqId = IR.inReqId WHERE II.status = '입고완료' AND (IR.IsDelete IS NULL OR IR.IsDelete = 0) AND II.inDttmRecv >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY chart_key ORDER BY chart_key ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(OI.outDttmShip, '%Y-%m-%d') AS chart_key, SUM(OI.outQtyReq) AS total_quantity FROM outboundItems OI INNER JOIN outboundrequest ORQ ON OI.outReqId = ORQ.outReqId WHERE OI.status = '승인완료' AND (ORQ.IsDelete IS NULL OR ORQ.IsDelete = 0) AND OI.outDttmShip >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY chart_key ORDER BY chart_key ASC

SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, IR.inDttmReq, II.inDttmRecv)) FROM inboundItems II INNER JOIN inboundRequests IR ON II.inReqId = IR.inReqId WHERE II.status = '입고완료' AND (IR.IsDelete IS NULL OR IR.IsDelete = 0) AND II.inDttmRecv >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY

SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, ORQ.outDttmReq, OI.outDttmShip)) FROM outboundItems OI INNER JOIN outboundrequest ORQ ON OI.outReqId = ORQ.outReqId WHERE OI.status = '승인완료' AND (ORQ.IsDelete IS NULL OR ORQ.IsDelete = 0) AND OI.outDttmShip >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY

/* 최근 12개월 월별 평균 리드타임(요청→입고완료, 시간) */ SELECT DATE_FORMAT(X.y, '%Y-%m') AS ym, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, IR.inDttmReq, II.inDttmRecv)) AS avg_hours, COUNT(*) AS recv_cnt FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT( DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL DAY(CURDATE()) - 1 DAY), INTERVAL n.n MONTH), '%Y-%m-01' ) AS y FROM (SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11) n ) X LEFT JOIN inboundItems II ON II.inDttmRecv >= X.y AND II.inDttmRecv < DATE_ADD(X.y, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND II.status = '입고완료' LEFT JOIN inboundRequests IR ON IR.inReqId = II.inReqId AND (IR.IsDelete IS NULL OR IR.IsDelete = 0) GROUP BY X.y ORDER BY X.y

/* 최근 12개월 월별 평균 리드타임(요청→출고, 시간단위) */ SELECT DATE_FORMAT(X.y, '%Y-%m') AS ym, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, ORQ.outDttmReq, OI.outDttmShip)) AS avg_hours, COUNT(*) AS ship_cnt FROM ( /* 최근 12개월의 월 첫날 목록 */ SELECT DATE_FORMAT( DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL DAY(CURDATE()) - 1 DAY), INTERVAL n.n MONTH), '%Y-%m-01' ) AS y FROM (SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11) n) X LEFT JOIN outboundItems OI ON OI.outDttmShip >= X.y AND OI.outDttmShip < DATE_ADD(X.y, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND OI.status = '승인완료' LEFT JOIN outboundrequest ORQ ON ORQ.outReqId = OI.outReqId AND (ORQ.IsDelete IS NULL OR ORQ.IsDelete = 0) GROUP BY X.y ORDER BY X.y
